note: The three links batch 150 could not verify, now added. All three refuse automated fetches — VPM, KTLA and KGW returned 403 or hung up — so none of these headlines came from the page itself. Each was recovered another way and the route is recorded per item, because a headline is a quotation and where it came from is part of it. Two of the three dates are likewise derived rather than read: KTLA's from a syndicated copy of the same story, KGW's from the outlet's own video of the same piece. Neither is the article page's own timestamp and both are marked as such here.
